request.style: English, male solo baritone with warm choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft percussion, reverent and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A dream descends upon the sleeping mind
An angel speaks with a gentle sign
Do not be afraid to take her in
The Holy Spirit is the source within

[Chorus]
Behold the virgin shall conceive
And give birth to a holy seed
They will call him Immanuel
God with us, the true and real

[Verse]
She will give birth to a son
Name him Jesus, the chosen one
He will save his people from their sins
Fulfilling what the Lord has given

[Chorus]
Behold the virgin shall conceive
And give birth to a holy seed
They will call him Immanuel
God with us, the true and real

[Bridge]
When Joseph woke from his slumber deep
He rose and walked with humble feet
He did as the angel commanded him
Taking her home, the sacred whim

[Outro]
No relations until the child was born
He named him Jesus, the light of morn
